identity_boundary.ADHD: Specific NITRC file IDs fetched freshly over HTTPS and selected members matched the prior cache; SHA256 pins are locally measured, not publisher checksums or an immutable upstream release commitment.
identity_boundary.atlas: Exact CBIG Git commit and published Git blob SHA1 independently anchor the image, LUT and license; file SHA256 is locally measured.

license.ADHD: Nilearn description states usage is unrestricted for non-commercial research purposes; no unrestricted commercial or redistribution clearance inferred.
license.atlas: MIT text at the exact CBIG commit is retained; this does not change ADHD terms.

processing_lineage_limit: Released BOLD derivatives and supplied17confound columns; complete original preprocessing history is not independently established. No raw-acquisition or original-paper-finding claim.
